alternative_explanations: Finite-order bidirectional inference, parallel Markov BP or Re-Pair may reconstruct closure chains without a learned pushdown.
Exact performance may follow from a narrow delimiter grammar rather than a reusable learned state-update principle.
confounds: Depth changes both target count and trace length; report per-depth exact accuracy, bits and charged work rather than treating their slopes as a broad scaling law.
The local source corpus is visible screening evidence and not an independent hidden language holdout.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless learned_pushdown_masked_byte has exact_span_accuracy 1.0 in every K/depth cell and at least 0.25 advantage over both source-identical roles at every depth.
Discard unless the main role exceeds the strongest complete implementable classical control by at least 0.25 exact-span accuracy and lower bits_per_byte at every depth.
Discard if the main role is implementably Pareto-dominated, exceeds 4194304 state bytes, omits declared cost accounting or any mandatory control is incomplete.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap between whole-file train, validation and test roles.
Invalidate unless training traces have maximum delimiter depth two and held-out scoring traces have exact depths three, four and five.
Invalidate if an implementable role receives source paths, unpermuted delimiters, token kinds or hand-written opener/closer identities.
Invalidate unless all pushdown roles share code and constants and differ only in learned stack state, bounded finite state or frozen transition learning.
Invalidate if a public query exposes the masked closer, another test slot, or an evaluator-private delimiter identity.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify and end the exact exhaustive seven-symbol grammar search, deterministic pushdown, reset and output rule without tuning or another seed.
outcome_policy.null: Treat the exact rule as unresolved only if a recorded infrastructure failure prevents a discriminating comparison before seed completion.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only an unchanged three-seed adversarial/new-corpus replication; do not promote or tune.

predicted_outcome: The learned full-stack role will recover the permuted grammar and attain exact_span_accuracy 1.0 at every K/depth cell, exceed each source-identical role and strongest implementable control by at least 0.25 exact-span accuracy at every depth, lower bits per byte, and remain implementably Pareto non-dominated after exhaustive grammar-search fit cost.
promotion_criteria: This one-seed quick cannot promote; only an unchanged three-seed new-corpus replication may be authorized if every kill gate passes.
research_question: Does one symbol-equivariant learned pushdown rule trained only on depth-at-most-two real-source traces transfer exact closure-chain completion to depths three through five more accurately per full cost than bounded state, frozen transitions and all mandatory controls?
title: Observation-induced pushdown depth-transfer quick
